question: wiki/open-questions.md item 7: is an observe-only chain-disagreement warning (WP33 step and density rules at the end of warmup and on the retained draws, plus the leave-one-chain-out R-hat of ChainDisagreement) diagnostically accurate on the 17-model posteriordb screen at the sampler defaults: does it fire on the cells where a chain is actually wrong and stay silent elsewhere?
change_under_test: Observe-only telemetry and checks: walnutpie::ChainWindowSummary via RunTelemetry::warmup_end() (last slow warmup window: median and IQR of the selected-state log density, end-of-warmup step) and RunTelemetry::sampling_end() (the same over the retained transitions); diagnostics::ChainWarning (Summary::chain_warnings, Posterior::chain_warnings(), one Summary line per flagged chain; Python SampleResult.chain_warnings() and summary_table()). No sampler state changes; draws bit-identical (tests/kernel_fingerprint.rs and every existing test pass; tests/chain_warnings.rs checks the telemetry against observe-only rescue scoring).
sampler: owalnuts::sampler defaults exactly (Tuning::default(), Metric::diagonal(), Adaptation::default(), Init::uniform() starts, Limits::admit_worst_case(); DEFAULT_CHAIN_RESCUE = None); BridgeStan 2.9.0 ReplicatedStanTarget without STAN_THREADS; one arm only (the sampler is unchanged)
seeds_verified_unused: rg -w over this worktree (STUDIES, wiki, src, tests, examples, integrations; target/, posteriordb/, .venv excluded), the main checkout's STUDIES/wiki/src/tests and the nine sibling agents' new study directories found no use of 97461-97468 (97471, 97482, 97492, 97443, 97447 appear in options_flow seed inventories and were avoided).
run_order: the 51 screen cells: models in listed order, seeds ascending; then the 10 extra cells: hmm_drive_0 seeds ascending, then lotka_volterra seeds ascending; strictly sequential, each launched exactly once (create-new launch marker)
estimators: ArviZ 0.23.4 rank R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS (0.05/0.95), mean MCSE on the posteriordb reference parameters (BridgeStan constrained, transformed parameters included)

detectors.D1_warmup_step: end-of-warmup step < 0.1 x median end-of-warmup step over chains
detectors.D2_warmup_density: median over chains of the last-slow-window median log density minus the chain's median > 3 x median over chains of the within-chain IQR (window 450..950)
detectors.D3_sampled_density: the same rule over the 1,000 retained draws
detectors.D4_rhat_loo: diagnostics::ChainDisagreement on the unconstrained retained draws names the chain (max rank R-hat > 1.01 and <= 1.01 without the chain)
detectors.evaluation: detectors are recomputed in Python from the exported window summaries and compared with the Rust ChainWarning list on every cell

truth.T_gate: task-literal ground truth: any house gate fails OR some reference parameter's pooled mean is more than 3 reference SD from the posteriordb reference mean
truth.T_wrong: a chain is actually wrong: some chain's mean of some reference parameter is more than 3 reference SD from the reference mean (chain-level truth = the set of such chains)
truth.T_rhat: reported only: R-hat gate fails OR T_wrong
truth.process_errors: cells without draws (sampler error, timeout, crash) are reported and excluded from every confusion matrix

decision.population: all process-valid cells (screen + extra); screen-only reported
decision.rule: Rule A: the first candidate in order C1..C5 with specificity >= 0.9 on T_gate-negative cells and sensitivity >= 0.8 on T_gate-positive cells ships as a validated gate-failure detector. Otherwise Rule B: the first candidate in order meeting both thresholds against T_wrong ships as the chain-disagreement warning (documented as covering one-wrong-chain failures only, not a substitute for the R-hat/ESS gates). Otherwise no warning line ships in Summary/Python output: the ChainWindowSummary telemetry and the ChainWarning type remain as draw-neutral data and the existing ChainDisagreement line is unchanged. The shipped candidate's detectors are exactly those ChainWarning emits; detectors outside it are removed from ChainWarning::detect.

exploratory_sweep.note: reported only; cannot ship or change the decision

P1.text: C1 sensitivity against T_gate (fails rule A: ESS- and divergence-only failures have no wrong chain)

P7.text: decision: no candidate meets rule A; C1 meets rule B and ships as the chain-disagreement warning

P8.text: the Rust ChainWarning list equals the Python recomputation on every process-valid cell

P9.text: draws bit-identical: tests/kernel_fingerprint.rs and the full cargo test suite pass with the telemetry in place

rules: Report all cells; failures are results; no reruns, no tuning after seeing results; a cell is launched once (a crash or timeout is a result). Walls are measured on a 16-core machine shared with nine other agents and are labelled contended; gradient counts, ESS, R-hat and reference distances are the evidence.
